title: A Long-Term Extension Study of IMVT-1402 in Adult Patients With Graves' Disease
official: A Long-Term Extension Study to Assess the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of IMVT-1402 in Adult Patients With Graves' Disease
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of IMVT-1402 as assessed by maintenance of euthyroidism, off ATD, and off IMVT-1402 for 52 weeks in Group A Participants
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants who completed Study IMVT-1402-2502 or Study IMVT-1402-2503.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Have permanently discontinued IMP during the treatment period in the feeder study or have met study stopping criteria at any point up until the end of participation in the feeder study
